transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is essential for the ATM system, ensuring secure transactions and user data protection. TRU-01 mandates encryption during data transmission to protect sensitive information. TRU-02 emphasizes secure PIN authentication to prevent unauthorized access. TRU-03 requires comprehensive logging for audit purposes, while TRU-04 and TRU-03 ensure transactions do not lead to negative balances, enhancing integrity. TRU-05 allows users to review their history securely. TRU-06 ensures users are notified of insufficient funds, and TRU-07 maintains data integrity by validating operations. These requirements collectively enhance security and user trust.

transcript.statement: Sustainability is crucial in the ATM system to minimize environmental impact. requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The system shall automatically notify users before any automatic withdrawals occur, ensuring conditions are met.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The system shall notify users immediately if a transaction cannot be completed due to insufficient funds.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: User notifications before withdrawals ensure both safety and efficiency.
Merging prevents redundancy in preventing negative balances.
Merging ensures a single requirement for notifying users of insufficient funds.
